title: Cultural Conditioning or Placebo? On the Effectiveness of Socio-Demographic Prompting

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model response variations by conditioning prompts with culturally sensitive semantic proxies (e.g., country of residence, personal names, food preferences, kinship terms) versus culturally non-sensitive placebos (e.g., house numbers, diseases) across multiple-choice datasets of varying cultural sensitivity to distinguish true cultural conditioning from random prompt perturbation effects.
